style.styleTitle: Everlands Imperial Pine Pre Lit Snowy Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: A delightful addition to indoor Christmas spaces, this mini Christmas Tree brings festive cheer into smaller areas with ease. It's 50 warm white LEDs ensure a cosy ambiance. With a handy 6-hour timer, the tree lights up automatically, offering a steady glow with ease. The green cable blends effortlessly into the tree's lush appearance, and the jute bag foot adds a rustic charm. - Height: 90 cm, Diameter: 46 cm - Pre-lit with 50 warm white LEDs - Soft needle PVC with snowy finish - Requires 3x AA batteries (not included) and features a 6-hour timer This charming mini tree is designed for indoor use, creating a cosy Christmas atmosphere for apartments, offices or anywhere else that needs a festive touch.
